mapper.sql: id, user_id, title, summary, content, status, views, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article (user_id, title, summary, content, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.status, a.views, a.user_id AS authorId, u.nickname AS authorNickname, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM article a JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.views, a.user_id AS authorId, u.nickname AS authorNickname, a.created_at FROM article a JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.user_id
a.status = 'published'
AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND a.user_id = #{query.authorId}
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC
